findings.evidence: `rw [..., ContinuousLinearMap.comp_assoc, ← ContinuousLinearMap.comp_assoc _ D.rankEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_symm_comp_coe, ContinuousLinearMap.id_comp, ← ContinuousLinearMap.comp_assoc, ← Φ.coordChange_comp_operator ..., Q.core.coordChange_self_eq_id hk, ContinuousLinearMap.id_comp]`
findings.fix: After the domain-specific rewrites (`chartToQ_eq_operator`, `coordChange_comp_operator`, `coordChange_self_eq_id`), close the regrouping with `simp [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_assoc]` or `ext; simp`. Alternatively, add a lemma `rankEquiv_symm_comp_rankEquiv` and use it.
findings.issue: `chartToQ_comp_coordChange` rewrites through about 12 named lemmas in each `V` branch: `comp_assoc` back and forth with explicit arguments, `coe_symm_comp_coe`, `id_comp`, `coordChange_self_eq_id`. The chain depends on the exact term shape and breaks when Mathlib renames these lemmas. `coordChange_comp_chartToQ` has a shorter chain of the same kind.

findings.evidence: The `have hs : D.baseSet i ∩ D.baseSet j ⊆ P.core.baseSet i ∩ P.core.baseSet j`, `... ⊆ P.core.baseSet j ∩ Q.core.baseSet i` and `... ⊆ D.baseSet i ∩ Q.core.baseSet j` blocks appear in both `continuousOn_coordChange` and `contMDiffOn_coordChange_glue`.
findings.fix: Add lemmas to the topological file, for example `baseSet_inter_subset_of_mem_of_mem`, `baseSet_inter_subset_of_notMem_of_mem` and `baseSet_inter_subset_of_notMem`, and use them in both proofs.
findings.issue: `contMDiffOn_coordChange_glue` repeats the three-way case split of `continuousOn_coordChange` in the topological file. The three chart-domain subset proofs `hs` are copied word for word, each one a `rw [baseSet_of_mem/notMem]; exact fun x hx ↦ ⟨...⟩`. Repeating them hides reusable facts about `D.baseSet`.

findings.evidence: `have hpre : ContDiff ℝ n fun f ... ↦ f.comp D.rankEquiv.symm.toContinuousLinearMap := (contDiff_id.clm_comp contDiff_const).restrict_scalars ℝ` appears in both theorems.
findings.fix: State `contDiff_comp_rankEquiv_symm` and `contDiff_rankEquiv_comp` once, as private lemmas or lemmas in the topological file, and use them in both proofs.
findings.issue: The `C^n` fact for pre-composing with the reindexing equivalence, `hpre`, is proved twice: once in `contMDiffOn_chartToQ` and once in `contMDiffOn_coordChange_glue`. The matching fact for post-composing, `hpost`, is also inline. These are repeated, reusable facts.

summary: `chartToQ_comp_coordChange` rests on a long, brittle chain of rewrites that only reorder compositions. The chart-domain subset facts and the reindexing smoothness facts are copied between the continuity and smoothness proofs instead of being lemmas.
